title: make dev's job worker waits for its running job before restarting on new code
request: The owner, 2026-10-26: an intern turn in make dev failed with 'Interrupted: the worker stopped before it finished' a minute after it started.
spec: scripts/dev.py: supervise_worker(busy=, max_hold=) holds a code-change restart while a job runs (at most 15 minutes), then restarts on the new code; serve passes busy as a count of running jobs in make dev's database (running_jobs).
plan: Hold the restart while a job runs, never for ever
Test both and the query on the real database

decisions.decision: Hold the restart while a job runs, at most 15 minutes
decisions.why: other sessions edit dclab_rnd all day; a restart in the middle of a person's turn loses it, while a held one only delays new code; the limit keeps a stuck 'running' row from blocking new code for ever

decisions.decision: Read the running jobs from the job table, and treat an unreadable table as idle
decisions.why: the supervisor runs outside the worker; a failed read must never stop a restart

change: scripts/dev.py (running_jobs; supervise_worker busy and max_hold; serve passes them); tests/test_dev_script.py (2 tests)

findings.defect: a person's intern turn was cut off by an unrelated code change
findings.scenario: the owner's turn started 10:43; another session saved dclab_rnd/store/keepers/dclab_code.py at 10:44:09; the worker restarted at 10:44:21 and the turn ended 'Interrupted: the worker stopped before it finished'
findings.cause: make dev restarted the job worker on any Python change under dclab_rnd, whatever it was running
findings.fix: a code change waits for the running job to end (at most 15 minutes), then restarts the worker on the new code

measurements.name: tests.test_dev_script
measurements.gate: a code change while a job runs keeps the worker until the job ends, then restarts; a job that never ends releases the restart after max_hold; the old restart test unchanged
measurements.result: 16 tests pass; running_jobs read the real dclab_dev job table (0 running)
limits: a job whose worker died stays 'running' until it is recovered: it can hold a restart up to the limit

outcome: In make dev, code saved by another session no longer cuts off a running intern turn, stage run or pipeline; the new code loads when the job ends.
lessons: A development reloader must not end work a person started: restart between jobs, not inside one
risks: make dev itself must be restarted once to run the new supervisor
